abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Strike of the Heavens
abilities.description: When Kwang damages an Enemy with an ability his Heavenly Blade becomes Energized with electricity for 4s, stacking up to 3 times. Whilst Energized, Kwang gains 45% attack speed and his next basic attack strikes lightning from above dealing 10.0/12.0/14.0/16.0/18.0/21.0/24.0/27.0/30.0/33.0/37.0/41.0/45.0/49.0/53.0/57.0/62.0/67.0 (+4 per level)(+20% magical power) magical damage to the Target and nearby Enemies. If this damages an Enemy Hero, Kwang reduces his basic ability cooldowns by 0.5s per stack.

abilities.name: Judgement of the Heavens
abilities.description: Throw the Heavenly Blade at a target location to deal 90.0/115.0/140.0/165.0/190.0 (+40% magical power) magical damage. Enemies hit by the Blade will be Tethered to it for 1.3s. When in the world, the Blade grants vision in a small area around it. Recalling the Blade early will break the Tether.

abilities.name: Surge of the Heavens
abilities.description: Kwang dashes forward, becoming Unselectable and dealing 75.0/100.0/125.0/150.0/175.0 (+45% magical power) to all Enemy Units he passes through. When the Blade is in the world, if Kwang dashes within 300 units of its radius he will summon it back to his hand with a crash of lightning, dealing the damage to all nearby Enemy Units and Knocking them Up for 0.25s.

abilities.name: Light of the Heavens
abilities.description: Light strikes the Heavenly Blade, dealing damage to nearby Enemy Units. While holding the Blade, it deals 75.0/110.0/145.0/180.0/215.0 (+60% magical power)(+70% physical power) magical damage and grants Kwang a 65.0/95.0/125.0/155.0/185.0 (+40% magical power) (+9% max health) Shield for 2.5s. If the Blade is in the world, it deals 90.0/125.0/160.0/195.0/230.0 (+80% magical power)(+80% physical power) true damage instead.

abilities.name: Fury of the Heavens
abilities.description: Channel a strike with the Heavenly Blade, dealing 230.0/340.0/450.0 (+80% magical power) magical damage and applying a 45.0/55.0/65.0% Slow for 2s to nearby Enemy Units. If the Blade is in the world, Kwang will Teleport to it before striking.

augments.name: Slayer of the Heavens
augments.description: Strike of the Heavens deals 25% more damage and reduces Cooldowns by 25% more.

augments.name: Aura of the Heavens
augments.description: Gain 5% Omnivamp. Nearby Allied Heroes gain 4% Omnivamp.

augments.name: Heavenly Tactician
augments.description: Fury of the Heavens' Cooldown is reduced by 20s and Kwang no longer retrieves his Heavenly Blade upon Recalling.
